Type: cabinet
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Pieced-Wood Reclaimed-Fir Storage Media Console, 63"W, Natural Stain
The pattern created by the pieced, reclaimed wood construction is visually satisfying, turning this very functional console or slim coffee table into an artistic statement. The 2 cabinets with hinged doors and 2 open shelves create welcome additional storage. 16.54"L x 63"W x 21.65"H Reclaimed fir atop a brass-painted metal base The 2 cabinet spaces with doors and 2 open shelves offer ample storage opportunities, both hidden and on display. A sturdy metal base adds stability while not drawing attention from the beautiful wood pattern. Assemble in 15 minutes or less. Avoid moisture; wipe clean with a soft, dry cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty
